## Summary
- Explain why this change is needed.

## Changes
- List key implementation changes.

## Validation
- [ ] Lint (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Typecheck (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Tests (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Coverage (`npm run test:coverage` or `npm run test:coverage:changed` when `src/lib` changes)
- [ ] E2E (`npm run test:e2e` when user-critical flows change)
- [ ] Build (`npm run build`)

## Coverage
- Command used: `npm run test:coverage` / `npm run test:coverage:changed` / `n/a`
- Overall or changed-file coverage: <percent or n/a>

## Risks
- Note any migration, backward compatibility, or rollout risks.

## Handoff
- Delivery phase completed: planning / implementation / qa
- Merge readiness: ready / blocked (reason)
